the jacket rips at the seams

Herby pork sausage rolls wrapped in pastry that's a size too small, so the filling bursts out the seams, with smoky tomato relish. Mix 500g pork sausage mince with 1 grated onion, 1 grated carrot, 1 tbsp chopped sage and 40g breadcrumbs. Cut 3 sheets puff pastry in half. Lay a sausage of filling along each, wrap so the edges only just meet and press loosely so they split in the oven. Brush with beaten egg and cut into 4 pieces each. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with 200g tomato relish.
M: Beef simmered loose with tomato, cinnamon, cumin, allspice and a square of dark chocolate for 90 minutes, ladled over spaghetti and buried in finely grated cheddar.
for the factory crew in Sandusky

Beef sausages and cheeseburgers off the grill, with charred corn in chilli butter and a creamy potato salad, the way you feed a factory floor. Boil 1kg washed potatoes until tender, cool, cut up and toss with 150g mayonnaise, 1 tbsp Dijon mustard, 2 chopped spring onions and dill. Shape 500g beef mince into 4 patties. Grill 8 thick beef sausages over medium heat for 15 minutes, turning. Grill the patties 4 minutes a side with a cheddar slice on top. Grill 4 corn cobs 10 minutes and brush with 40g butter mixed with chilli flakes. Serve with buns and sauces.
W: Sweet-sour cherries baked in a crisp shortcrust under a woven lattice top, served warm with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. Toss 800g pitted cherries (frozen is fine) with 150g caster sugar, 3 tbsp cornflour and the juice of half a lemon. Line a 23cm pie dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust and fill with the cherries. Cut 2 more sheets into strips and weave a lattice on top, then brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes until bubbling. Cool 1 hour and serve with vanilla ice cream.
K: Tommy and Richard on the road selling brake pads

Ice-cold lager topped with homemade fizzy lemonade of fresh lemon and sugar syrup, served in chilled pint glasses with a lemon wheel. Mix 120ml fresh lemon juice with 100ml sugar syrup and chill. Chill 4 pint glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Pour 30ml of the lemon mix into each glass, add 165ml cold soda water, then top slowly with 330ml cold lager each. Stir once and add a lemon wheel. Use extra soda water and lemon for anyone driving.

s.note: chocolate and peanut butter, Ohio's own sweet
s.how: Beat 250g smooth peanut butter with 60g soft butter and 200g icing sugar, roll into 24 small balls and chill 30 minutes. Melt 200g dark chocolate, dip each ball on a toothpick leaving a round of peanut butter showing at the top, set on baking paper in the fridge for 20 minutes.

s.note: the kitchen's closed, Tommy wants wings
s.how: Pat 1kg chicken wings dry and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Bake on a rack at 220C for 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp. Toss in 80ml hot sauce melted with 40g butter. Mix 80g blue cheese with 125g sour cream for a dip and serve with celery sticks.

m.how: Simmer 600g beef mince in 750ml water, breaking it up fine. Add 1 diced onion, 400g crushed tomatoes, 2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cinnamon, 1 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp allspice, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and 15g dark chocolate. Simmer 90 minutes until thick. Ladle over 400g cooked spaghetti and pile 200g finely grated cheddar on top.
